# Amuajema Contractors

> Amuajema Contractors is the public-facing brand of AMUAJEMA LIMITED, a local Tanzanian specialist civil contractor registered with the Contractors Registration Board.

## Company facts
- Legal name: AMUAJEMA LIMITED
- Registration number: SPC3/1273/02/2022
- Contractor type: Specialist Civil
- Class: 3
- Category: Local
- Managing Director: Jane Shedaffa
- Address: Plot No. 426 Block D, Nyegezi, Malimbe, Mwanza, Tanzania
- Postal address: P.O. Box 110311, Mwanza
- Phone: +255 754 068 145
- Email: erickfbyn@gmail.com

## Services
- Building construction
- Specialist civil works and external works
- Renovation and fit-out
- Maintenance and project support
